Sub-Saharan Africa

Season near baseline

Sub-Saharan Africa logged 8,917 cases in September 2026, running slightly below the seasonal baseline.

Year-to-date totals sit at 53,115, tracking near the expected burden.

Data refreshed: 04 October 2026

Burkina Faso

Burkina Faso is estimated to have experienced 30,593 cases this year to date. This is 1.6× the number of cases reported in an average year. This year the dengue situation in Burkina Faso is above average.
